metadata.title: Designing a Verifiable, Non-Amending Civilizational Memory Record for Future AI Agents: The Trinity Accord Case Study
metadata.description: An artifact-centered design case examining how a bounded human-origin record can preserve canonical closure, provenance roles, availability layers, bounded verification, instruction safety, and machine discoverability without allowing later layers to amend the source object. The report is author-produced, AI-assisted, not peer reviewed, and not an independent verification report.
metadata.notes: Technical Report TA-TR-2026-01. Preprint, not peer reviewed. The report analyzes the Trinity Accord but does not amend its three Bitcoin Originals. OpenAI language-model tools assisted under the named author's direction; the named author is responsible for publication and claims.
